home.layout: Full-width hero with network tagline in large Fraunces serif over deep purple gradient, persistent audio player widget, 3-column show artwork grid below, featured episode card, newsletter strip, support CTA section.

shows.layout: Header with title and genre filter pills, responsive 3-4 column grid of large square show cover art cards with title, description, and subscribe platform icons below each.

episodes.layout: Search bar and show filter dropdown at top, vertical list of episode cards each with thumbnail artwork, mono episode number, title, show name, date, duration, and circular play button.

episode.layout: Two-column layout with sticky embedded audio player and large artwork on left, episode title, show notes with timestamped chapters, guest bios, and transcript link on right.

support.layout: Mission statement hero, three-tier membership comparison cards centered with coral CTA on featured tier, Patreon embed strip, one-time donation block, merchandise preview grid.
